items.title: Audit the step contract matrix for complete inputs, outputs, evidence, missing-evidence handling, and verifier ownership
items.context: Review docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md Step Contract Matrix and Evidence Failure Policy for missing responsibilities or ambiguous proof sources.
items.userSees: User sees the heading "Step Contract Matrix" followed by rows for Step 0 through Step 7 and columns for inputs, outputs, required evidence, missing/stale handling, and verifier.

happy.desc: Step Contract Matrix has rows for state intake, PLAN skeleton, reviewer lanes, evidence, preflight, live smoke, delivery, and done_prepare delegation.

edge.desc: Rows distinguish upstream evidence refresh from TEST-to-DONE stale refresh owned by done_prepare.

adversarial.desc: No row allows stale proof to become fresh by direct hash rewrite or main-agent self-signing.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Step Contract Matrix|Evidence Failure Policy|TEST-to-DONE readiness delegation|done_prepare" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Command found the Step Contract Matrix, Evidence Failure Policy, and done_prepare delegation rows covering Step 0 through Step 7.
Document distinguishes upstream evidence planning from TEST-to-DONE stale refresh owned by done_prepare.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "never rewrite hashes directly|main agent must not self-sign|no second implementation of DONE readiness" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Document explicitly blocks hash rewriting, main-agent delivery self-signing, and a second DONE readiness implementation.

items.title: Audit the text and image flowcharts for alignment with the step contract and B-fb36 done_prepare boundary
items.context: Confirm both flowcharts show proof-or-stop behavior and delegate TEST-to-DONE readiness to done_prepare instead of duplicating DONE closure logic.
items.userSees: User sees the heading "Flowcharts", a text flowchart block, and the image link "Lattice standard evidence pipeline flow" pointing at the SVG asset.

happy.desc: The text flowchart lists the full state intake through DONE delegation path with explicit stop points.

edge.desc: The image/SVG flowchart visually distinguishes ordinary preflight from TEST-to-DONE done_prepare delegation.

adversarial.desc: Neither flowchart depicts story_pipeline as independently running main merge, stale TEST evidence refresh, validation, or done_closure for DONE readiness.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Text Flowchart|State intake|Delegate to lattice done_prepare|DONE readiness PASS" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Text flowchart includes full state intake through done_prepare delegation and DONE readiness pass path.
SVG flowchart is valid XML and was created as the rendered image artifact for the pipeline flow.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Delegate to lattice done_prepare|duplicating `done_closure`, main-sync, evidence-refresh, or version-bump|not a second implementation of DONE readiness" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Flow and boundary text show story_pipeline delegates DONE readiness rather than independently running merge, refresh, validation, or done_closure.

items.title: Audit the implementation split for safe parallel development without duplicate gate truth sources
items.context: Review the parallel tracks and suggested story breakdown for clear ownership, safe dependencies, and no second implementation of lifecycle gates, delivery review, or done_prepare behavior.
items.userSees: User sees Track A through Track G and P1 through P7 explicitly say DONE readiness is delegated to "done_prepare" where applicable.

happy.desc: P1-P7 identify owners, deliverables, dependencies, and parallel-safety notes.

edge.desc: Tracks that touch delivery, evidence refresh, review gates, or DONE readiness name their dependency on existing gates or done_prepare.

adversarial.desc: No track claims permission to replace reviewer lanes, delivery reviewer signatures, Authority receipts, or done_prepare TEST-to-DONE readiness behavior.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Track A|Track G|P1 \| Add story pipeline preflight report|P7 \| Integrate top-level `story_pipeline` command" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Parallel development plan identifies Track A through Track G and P1/P7 integration ownership.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "owned by `done_prepare`|reviewer lanes|delivery reviewer|done_prepare report import/delegation" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Tracks touching delivery, evidence refresh, reviewer lanes, and DONE readiness name the existing gate or done_prepare owner.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "replace reviewer lanes with a single host self-review|delivery-check.json only through the delivery reviewer lane|no push, no Authority DONE claim|not by replacing it" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Document rejects replacing reviewer lanes, delivery reviewer signatures, Authority claims, or done_prepare behavior.

auditLog.reason: Step contract matrix and evidence failure policy documented and covered by docs_check evidence.
Text flowchart, Mermaid source, and SVG flowchart documented and covered by docs_check evidence.
Parallel development split documented and covered by docs_check evidence for done_prepare and gate truth-source boundaries.
